risk_note: RV2 (identity wires the request-identity ports other modules define: catalog's ViewerContext, linking's CallerContext and AttrCodeReader; BR-ATTR-05 / BR-ATTR-06 / BR-AI-03, 02 §4.1). Identity is resolved on every call from what the request checks verified: the token principal first (app_id, uid, device_id), else the signature-verified device as that app's guest, else an X-App-Id guest; bodies, query strings and raw X-Device-Id / X-User-Id are never read. attr_code is read from users on every call (app_id + id, status <> 'deleted'); missing, deleted, empty or non-uuid gives null, never the user_id; database failures propagate unchanged. CatalogModule.forRoot / LinkingModule.forRoot take optional port overrides (defaults byte-identical to before); app.module passes identity's implementations on the api entry only. Frozen landing test [AC-B1-06j#5] lost its pre-identity row through test-change B1-02p (#286) first. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
